name: TakePicture_1
short_caption: The robot mimics holding a camera up to its eyes and taking a picture.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises both arms symmetrically outwards, bringing its hands up to frame its eyes as if holding up a camera. It holds this pose for a brief moment, simulating taking a photograph, before lowering its arms back down to its sides to return to the neutral posture.
safety_notes: The arms sweep outwards and upwards, requiring clear lateral space around the upper body.
